# Consumer Repo Setup Checklist

This compatibility stub keeps older inbound links alive.

Use the canonical checklist instead:

- [`templates/consumer-repo/docs/SETUP_CHECKLIST.md`](../../templates/consumer-repo/docs/SETUP_CHECKLIST.md)

The canonical checklist is the maintained source for consumer repository setup,
CI script wiring, keepalive routing, and bootstrap settings. It is the copy
synced into consumer repositories via `.github/sync-manifest.yml`; this
`docs/templates/` copy previously drifted (it was missing the CI helper-script
and Maint 83 bootstrap sections), so it now redirects here to avoid serving a
stale checklist.
